segments.description: Clinical-stage biotechnology company developing neflamapimod for age-related brain disorders including dementia with Lewy bodies, frontotemporal disorders, and other neurologic conditions.
segments.evidence: CervoMed Inc. has one reportable segment which consists of the development of clinical and nonclinical product candidates for treatments for age-related neurologic disorders and other medical indications.
